ground.label: Background
ground.note: The colour behind this section. Change it between one section and the next so the page reads as bands instead of one flat colour.

plain.label: Default
plain.note: The page's own background colour. Quiet, and the right choice for most sections.

soft.label: Light
soft.note: A soft tint. The easiest way to separate one section from the one above it.

layout.label: Arrangement
layout.note: How the footer's three parts - your menu, the legal links and the copyright - are laid out on a computer screen. On a phone both look the same: stacked and centred.

line.label: Centred
line.note: Everything centred, one group under the next. Light and quiet; right under a short page.

columns.label: Columns
columns.note: Your menu, the legal links and the copyright side by side in three columns, the way most established sites close. Right under a long page with a lot on it.

mark.label: Logo
mark.note: Whether your logo appears in the footer, above everything else.

none.label: No logo
none.note: The footer without your logo. The default, and right for a logo that only works on a dark background.

logo.label: Show the logo
logo.note: Your logo above the footer's contents, a touch larger than in the header, linking back to the homepage.
